tasks.title: Plan stage checkpoint read/write and round-skip logic
tasks.description: Modify `runPlanStage()` to: (1) read checkpoint on entry via `checkpointRepo.get(issue.number, 'plan')`, (2) skip `cleanChangeDir()` if checkpoint has non-empty `completedSteps`, (3) in the rounds loop, for each round check if it's in `completedSteps` — if so, verify artifact exists on disk via `round.verify()`, skip if present or re-run if missing (disk is truth per pipeline-model spec), (4) after each round completes and verifies, call `checkpointRepo.upsert()` to update `completedSteps` and `nextStep`, (5) create initial checkpoint if none exists, (6) delete checkpoint when plan stage returns success. Preserve checkpoint on stage failure so resume can continue from last completed step.
acceptanceCriteria: runPlanStage reads checkpoint before round loop starts
cleanChangeDir is skipped when checkpoint has non-empty completedSteps
Rounds in completedSteps with artifact on disk are skipped (no conn.prompt call)
Rounds in completedSteps but missing artifact are re-executed
Checkpoint is upserted after each successful round completion
Checkpoint is deleted when runPlanStage returns success:true
No checkpoint is written when checkpointRepo is undefined (backward compatible)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The self-review round at the end of plan stage should be treated as a separate step in the checkpoint (type='self-review').

This requires adding a `skipTaskIds` option and `onTaskCompleted` callback to `RalphExecutor` config.
acceptanceCriteria: runPipelineBuildStage reads checkpoint and extracts completedTaskIds before execution
RalphExecutor accepts skipTaskIds parameter and skips those tasks
RalphExecutor accepts onTaskCompleted callback invoked after each task pass
Checkpoint is upserted with completed task IDs during execution
Checkpoint is deleted when build stage returns success:true
No checkpoint logic runs when checkpointRepo is undefined
Typecheck passes
